# webpiano

> webpiano is a free, browser-based two-octave piano designed for immediate play with a computer keyboard, pointer, or touch. It requires no account, download, or sign-up.

Important notes:

- The main page is the playable instrument.
- The lower octave uses Z–M and the upper octave uses Q–U, with nearby keys for sharps.
- Holding Space controls sustain.
- A second phone can optionally act as a real-time sustain pedal.
- Played notes and synthesized audio stay in the browser.

## Product

- [Play webpiano](https://webpiano.xyz): Open the playable online piano.
